description: LHTLP puzzles (Malavolta-Thyagarajan 2019) from fixed parameters. Seed derivation (src/core/vectors.ts): seededBytes(label, length) concatenates SHA-256 blocks sha256(seedDomain + '/' + label + u32be(counter)) for counter = 0, 1, 2, ..., truncated to length bytes; seededScalar(label, order) reduces seededBytes(label + '#' + attempt, 48) mod order, retrying attempt = 0..7 on a zero result; seededSquareUnit(label, n) squares seededScalar(label, n) mod n after checking it is coprime to n. p, q are the public Mersenne primes 2^31-1 and 2^61-1 (independently verifiable primality) -- this is a toy-scale, 92-bit modulus chosen for test speed, not a sizing suggestion; contrast the VTD vectors' full ~648-bit modulus and the KEM vectors' full-range BLS12-381 scalars, both realistic. g = seededSquareUnit(gSeed, n); h = g^(2^t) mod n. Each "create" vector derives r = seededScalar(rSeed, n) and pins u, v, and the value solvePuzzle recovers. "add" and "scale" vectors reference other vectors by id and pin the homomorphic result. All bigints are decimal strings. Independently cross-checked: h and u via a from-scratch recursive modPow; the full create/add/scale/solve chain via exact-arithmetic assertions (solvedSum == secret1+secret2, solvedScaled == secret1*7).
